Liver Cirrhosis

Ailment liver-cirrhosis fibrosis liver-disease hepatitis detoxification

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Chronic liver disease characterized by scarring (fibrosis) of liver tissue, affecting liver function and detoxification.

Symptoms

  • fatigue
  • yellowing of skin/eyes
  • abdominal swelling
  • confusion
  • easy bruising
  • loss of appetite
